import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
import warnings
import sys

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data files from input directory
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Get target columns from sample submission
target_cols = [col for col in sample_sub.columns if col != "id"]
print(f"Target columns: {len(target_cols)} species")

# Get feature columns (remove id and species/id columns)
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "species"]]
print(f"Feature columns: {len(feature_cols)} features")

features_train = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
features_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()

X_train_full = features_train.values.astype(float)
X_test_full = features_test.values.astype(float)

# Convert species labels to integers
y_train_classes = train_df["species"].values
le = LabelEncoder()
y_train_encoded = le.fit_transform(y_train_classes)

# Split data for genuine validation - NEVER refit model on this data
X_train, X_val, y_train_enc, y_val_enc = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_encoded,
    test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_encoded, shuffle=True
)

# Train model on FULL training data ONLY
clf = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", random_state=42)
clf.fit(X_train, y_train_enc)

# Validate on held-out validation set (truly unseen)
y_pred_proba_val = clf.predict_proba(X_val)

def compute_multiclass_log_loss(y_true_onehot, y_pred_proba, epsilon=1e-15):
    """Compute multi-class logarithmic loss as per competition specification"""
    # y_true must be one-hot encoded (same shape as number of samples x num_classes)
    return -np.mean(
        np.sum(
            y_true_onehot
            * np.log(np.clip(y_pred_proba + epsilon, epsilon, 1 - epsilon)),
            axis=1,
        )
    )

n_classes = len(target_cols)
y_val_onehot = np.zeros((len(y_val_enc), n_classes))
for i, idx in enumerate(y_val_enc):
    y_val_onehot[i, int(idx)] = 1

log_loss_val = compute_multiclass_log_loss(y_val_onehot, y_pred_proba_val)
print(f"Validation Multi-class Log Loss (Hold-out): {log_loss_val:.6f}")

# Prepare final predictions on TEST SET
y_pred_proba_test = clf.predict_proba(X_test_full)

# Create submission dataframe based on sample_submission template
sub_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df["id"].astype(str)})
for i, col_name in enumerate(target_cols):
    sub_df[col_name] = y_pred_proba_test[:, i]

# Clip probabilities ONLY in numeric columns (exclude 'id' column which is string)
numeric_only = ~sub_df.dtypes == object
sub_df[numerics_columns = sub_df.columns[numeric_only]] = sub_df[numerics_columns].applymap(
    lambda x: max(min(x, 1 - 1e-15), 1e-15)
)

# Save submission file
sub_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

# Verify submission exists
if os.path.exists("./submission/submission.csv"):
    submission_file = pd.read_csv("./submission/submission.csv")
    print(f"\n=== Submission Verification ===")
    print(f"Submitted predictions shape: {submission_file.shape}")
    print(f"Number of images: {len(submission_file)}")
    print(f"Species columns: {len(target_cols)}")
    print(f"\n{'='*50}")
    print(f"FINAL MULTI-CLASS LOG LOSS METRIC: {log_loss_val:.6f}")
else:
    print("ERROR: Submission file not created!")
    raise SystemExit(1)
